candidates.title: Prepare Pinterest posts from a CSV

demandEvidence.chore: Prepare and batch publish scheduled Pinterest posts from operator supplied CSV rows.
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: Beyond publishing, the node does schedules you can edit in place, batch publishing, CSV import, board access checks, asset uploads, analytics and webhooks for publish results.

ease.reason: A beginner could test operator supplied CSV rows and prepare a small Pinterest batch, but no supplied building reference documents the integration.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: professional service providers managing Pinterest accounts may pay for batch setup; this discussion proves no buyers or payment.

feasibility.reason: A four week prototype can format supplied sample rows for review; live account access, upload behavior and platform changes remain untested.

autonomy.reason: A repeatable CSV-to-batch preparation loop is plausible, but publishing mechanics lack reference support and a person must verify assets and approve posts.

evidence.reason: The fresh post describes schedules, batch publishing and CSV import, but gives little demand frequency detail or independent corroboration.

candidates.reason: Assessed a narrow experiment that formats operator supplied CSV rows into a reviewable Pinterest publishing batch. Its mean is 5.0, below the threshold of 6; the post supports the feature context but no implementation reference, buyer payment, or repeat frequency.

rejected.title: Prepare Pinterest posts from a CSV
rejected.reason: Below threshold: the narrow CSV-to-batch preparation experiment is plausible, but no supplied building source supports implementation, and the discussion does not establish repeat demand or payment.
